questions.stem: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
choices: APC is the site of the earliest known mutation in the chromosomal pathway to colon cancer.
Deletion of the p53 and DCC genes can lead to distant metastasis.
Villous adenomatous polyps are the most dangerous polyps.

evidence.quote: Hematomaous polyps, we already talked about, they are not um always benign, and they're the syndromes, juvenile polyposis syndrome, Putz-Jeger's syndrome, and the P10 hematomatous tumor syndrome.

questions.note:
A is the incorrect statement. Hamartomatous polyps are mostly benign, but not always. Juvenile polyposis syndrome, Peutz-Jeghers syndrome and PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome all carry a real cancer risk. The professor said the word "always" is what makes it wrong.
B is true: loss of APC (5q21) is the first step in the chromosomal instability pathway, turning normal mucosa into an early adenoma.
C is true: p53 and DCC are tumor suppressors whose loss comes late in the adenoma-carcinoma sequence, as the tumor moves toward invasion and metastasis.
D is true: among adenomas, villous histology carries the highest malignant potential.
